description: Calculate estimated pregnancy due date, current gestational age (weeks + days), trimester dates and key milestone weeks from last menstrual period (with custom cycle length), conception date, or Day 3/5/6 IVF transfer date. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/due-date-calculator.

asOfDate.description: Optional date YYYY-MM-DD to evaluate gestational week (default today)

cycleDays.description: Average menstrual cycle length in days (method=lmp)

date.description: Reference date YYYY-MM-DD (first day of LMP, conception or IVF transfer)

embryoDay.description: Embryo age at transfer for method=ivf: 3, 5 or 6

method.description: lmp (last period), conc (conception) or ivf (IVF transfer)

name: due_date_calculator
title: Pregnancy Due Date Calculator API - LMP, conception or IVF transfer milestones
